description: Specialized high-context, low-concurrency single-DGX-Spark profile pairing NVIDIA's exact Nemotron 3.5 Lightning NVFP4 target with its official DSpark companion at the declared 1M-token context. Its declared memory contract is tight, so it is not the default Nemotron text profile; physical GB10 latency, acceptance-rate, memory, and output-equivalence canaries are still required. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, as in NVIDIA's model card at bee75962 (the DGX Spark vLLM command, README lines 114 and 296). The steady per-node peak is 0.85 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B vLLM DSpark 1M latency single Spark (tight)
